text: __NOTOC__ Lorna's Watch is a small camp found in southwestern Stormheim. It was set up by Gilneas Brigade commander Lorna Crowley shortly after the crash of the Skyfire. It was used as a base of operations against the local vrykul in and around Hrydshal.
The Lotharian Lotus is a single flower growing at the feet of the statue of Anduin Lothar in the Black Tooth Hovel in the Burning Steppes.
__NOTOC__ The Lost Netherwhelp is a dragon whelp located at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

Lost Feathermane Kittens are skittish owlcat cubs found at the Feathermane Hunting Grounds in western Suramar. As the adults are dead due to the nearby Starving Ettin, adventurers have to chase them back to the safety of the rest of the pack.

The Hag of the Crooked Tree, more properly known as Lorrayne Sorrowheart, is a Highborne located outside Bradensbrook in Val'sharah. She is the youngest of the Sorrowheart sisters who managed to escape her hanging by slipping out of her noose. The Hat of the Youngest Sister belongs to her.

__NOTOC__ Lorthalium, ancient matriarch of the Frayfeather hippogryphs, periodically appears in the Frayfeather Highlands in Feralas during the Hatching of the Hippogryphs micro-holiday. She is normally , but turns to players who have the Frayfeather Hatchling (buff) buff.
Lost One Fishermen are Lost Ones located in the Swamp of Sorrows.
When used, the Lost Legend of the Valarjar unlocks pages of lore from the Favored of Odyn rune stone in Skyhold.
Lost Emberspit Scorpions are scorpions found in the Molten Front.
Lost Key can be fished from pools of Floating Garbage in Thousand Needles.

Lost Bloodtalon Hatchlings are raptor hatchlings found at Zalazane's Fall. Naj'tess is turning them into Corrupted Bloodtalons using his Orb of Corruption. Kijara provides Horde adventurers with a Bloodtalon Whistle to rescue 12 of the hatchlings from corruption.
Lorgos the Resurrector is an inquisitor located at Heroes' Rest in Val'sharah during the Legion Assaults.
The Lost Krokul Chest can be found in a cave in central Krokuun.
Lorraine Toussaint is a voice actress that voiced High Sage Viryx in World of Warcraft: Warlords of Draenor.

Lost Mail is obtainable in two different versions. The Bind on Pickup version is looted from the Lost Mail in Dalaran. The Bind on Use version is a reward from completing the Postmaster questline. It's purpose is to be given away to another player, and can be sold on the Auction House.
__NOTOC__ Lost Drakkari Spirits are ice troll ghosts located at Pools of Zha'Jin in Zul'Drak.
The Lostfin are a tribe of murlocs who live on the Broken Isles. They live in stilted huts by the shores.
Lost Mages were humans located in Drustvar. Their ID was reused for Captured Thornspeakers.
Lorlathil Druids are night elves located in Lorlathil in Val'sharah.
Lorlathil Sentries are night elves located at Lorlathil in Val'sharah.
The Lost Sailors' Memorial is a cenotaph found at a graveyard in Drustvar. Emily Mayville can be found kneeling in front of it.

Losing My Profession is an achievement that is awarded for killing NPCs in Waycrest Manor and Siege of Boralus on Mythic difficulty. The NPCs are summoned based on crafting professions. The following are located in Waycrest Manor: *Leatherworking - Huntmaster Grath *Tailoring - Seamstress Johanna *Herbalism - Groundskeeper Lilith *Inscription - Governess Tabitha *Cooking - Head Vintner Justin The following are located in Siege of Boralus: *Blacksmithing - Brutik Blackanvil *Engineering - Threshanator 3000 *Alchemy - Liz Vilepot
The Lost Grace of the Nightborne was a quest reward from Dark Revelations.
Loti's Totem is provided as an objective for Forbidden Practices. Placing it near Zanchuli Acolytes reveals that they are Crimson Cultists.
Lost Gatherers are spectres located in Azsuna. They guard an Aethril Cluster.
Loroja is a tortollan located in an underwater cave off the Jeweled Coast in Stormsong Valley.
Lost Coins are gathered by moving about with the Magnetized Metal Collector in highlighted areas in the Drowned Lands in Stormsong Valley.
Lost Tadpoles are murlocs located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus. Three of them can be found down at the waterline in front of Meg Morris.
Lost Icehoof Calves are clefthooves located in Frostfire Ridge.
Lorewalker Cho's Image is a projection of Lorewalker Cho located in A Little Patience and Dagger in the Dark.
__NOTOC__ The Lost Spirit Lounge is a fortune-telling parlor located in the Zocalo in Dazar'alor.

The Lost Veil pale is a group of pale orcs that dwell at Lost Veil Anzu in the Spires of Arak. Deep below in the cave, the third key to find the Amulet of Rukhmar is left on the ground. Alliance and Horde soldiers sent in their best scouts inside their dwelling to never return. Adventurers going in the area have a merciless one attaches itself to a host, forcing the adventurer to to its bidding such as consuming the plants in the cave and killing everything around it. Ultimately, they are turned into while mutations. They appear to be enemies of the Arakkoa Outcasts for they occupy the cave named after and they give reputation for every kill.
Loremaster of Kul Tiras is awarded for completing all three zone storyline achievements.

Lost Alpacas are alpacas that roam in a large area northeast of the Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun. They're escapees from Mugjabu's herd at the Scorched Sands Outpost. The one stationed at Deadwood Cove is unattackable. __NOTOC__
Lost Treasure Maps are looted from Disturbed Mud in the Broken Shore and Demonwaste Piles in Suramar.
Lost Offerings of Kimbul is located at the top of the hill above the Temple of Kimbul in Vol'dun. It contains 5-25 War Resources and two random vendor trash items.
Lorewalker Cho's Dream Brew is an object located in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. It was originally used for accessing scenarios.

Lost Honor is a cinematic that is set after the Battle for Lordaeron, focusing on Varok Saurfang, imprisoned in the Stormwind Stockades, and Anduin Wrynn. It serves as a tie-in for the Saurfang questline in patch 8.1. Lost Honor was released at BlizzCon 2018, November 2nd 2018.
The Lost Anchor Necklace is looted from monelite seams by miners with Mining Technique: Monelite Seam (Rank 2).
Loremaster of Zandalar is a Battle for Azeroth Horde quest achievement rewarded for completing the main stories of Zuldazar, Nazmir, and Vol'dun.
Loti's Favorite Longspear is a quest reward from Dire Situation.
__NOTOC__ Lost Spawns of Krag'wa are frogs located in Nazmir. They are part of the Hoppin' Sad achievement.
The Lost Estate is located in the Forgotten Cove, below the Precipice of Oblivion in Stormsong Valley.
Lotus Cranes are cranes located in Shang's Valley in the Jade Forest.
__NOTOC__ Lost Wardens are night elves located at the Scorched Plain in Mount Hyjal.
The Horde is up to something and we're gonna find out what, one way or another.
__NOTOC__ Lost Algan are algan located at the Ashen Strand in Nazjatar.
The Lost Scale of the Scarlet Broodmother is looted from the Blazing Scale at Vermillion Redoubt in the Twilight Highlands.
The Lost Watermelon is found throughout the Return to Karazhan. This fruit was added as part of the Riddle of Jenafur but is not required for it.
Loremaster's Notebook is provided as an objective for Aggressive Notation
Lost Picnic Supplies are found in the Horrid March in the Dread Wastes.
Louison is an abomination leftover located at the Challenger's Promenade in Maldraxxus.
Louison's Gristle Cutter is provided as an objective for How to Get a Head. It can be used on corpses of Predatory Bloodtusks and Bloodtusk Alphas in order to obtain Bloodtusk Skull.

__NOTOC__ Lost Soles can be fished from Lost Sole Schools in the Shadowlands. The chance to fish them up can be increased by using Lost Sole Bait. Loremaster of Shadowlands is a quest achievement earned by completing a series of Shadowlands quest achievements.
Lost Aspirants are kyrian located at the Court of Elation in Bastion.
__NOTOC__ Lorkron the Hunter is a Drust located in Ardenweald. He was sent to a hunt by Hunt-Captain Korayn which led him to be turned into a Drust and to serve a new master.
Lost Memories are four projections of Vol'jin located at Screaming Cliffs on the Broken Shore during Where He Fell.

Lorlidrel is a nightborne, who often ran errands and acted as a messenger for First Arcanist Thalyssra. At Thalyssra's command, he informed Zekhan at the Western Earthshrine that the Horde Council wished to see him and directed him through a portal to Grommash Hold

Lost Sybille is an ash ghoul located in the Ember Ward in Revendreth. While thoroughly insane, she is very loyal to Duke Theotar and serves him alongside his retainers, Tubbins and Gubbins. She speaks in bizarre rhyming sentences and is capable of speaking to other ash ghouls. She initially guides players searching for clues to Prince Renathal's location to Theotar. During the adventurer and Theotar's activities in the Ember Ward, she guides them to both Theotar's Hideout and the Sanctuary of the Mad. She appears to have once been a part of the venthyr in Sinfall, given the nathrezim express familiarity with her and how she has "returned" to the area. She has history with Sathrovarr the Corr

The Lost Journal is found at on the upper level of the Spire of the Unseen Guests on the surface level of Sinfall in Revendreth. It contains the book Enemy Infiltration - Preface. To see the journal, players must have completed the level-up campaign and chosen a covenant.
Lost Kyrian are dead Ascended kyrian located around the ripening pond in the center of the House of Constructs in Maldraxxus.
The Lost Quill is an animated object located in the Banewood in Revendreth. If given a bottle of Forbidden Ink, it will let the adventurer summon it whenever needed through the Refilling Inkwell.
Lost Dredgers are dredgers located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Lost Field Kit is located near the Eye of the Jailer in the Sanctum of Domination.

The Lost Memento is found at in the northwestern part of the Sanctuary of Guidance in northern Korthia by the outstretched hand of a dead Vault Warden. One of the Treasures of Korthia, loot the scroll to pick up the Lost Memento item, which contains a Tattered Scroll (Shadowlands) and a chunk of Concentrated Anima.

Lounging Patrons are brokers located at the Lap of Luxury in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
The Lost Satchel is found hanging dangerously off a branch at the northern edge of the Banks of Life in Ardenweald.
The Lost Attendant's Scepter drops from Mugrem the Soul Devourer in The Maw.
Lost Ovoids are found all around Zereth Mortis, typically at forges where poultrids are nearby.
Lost Mugs are looted from a Lost Mug in the Fear Clutch in the Dread Wastes.
Lost Keg is located in the Horrid March in the Dread Wastes.
Lost Winged Ritual Kris is looted from Forgotten Chests in Revendreth.
Lost Earrings are fished from the waters of the Shadowlands.
Lost Chalice Band is composed by Noko, Chiu Brightcask, and Lucky Ansel. They are found in the Chalice District in Revendreth and perform in the Ember Court.
Lost Soul Xiphos is sold by the following vendors in Bastion for 1 Abominable Anima Spherule: *Kelli Hoo *Alisius *Battlemaster Endios *Provisioner Prothos

The Lost Draconic Hourglass is found in Slyfox Den in the Forbidden Reach. Covering yourself in its contents causes you to experience Time Compression, increasing haste by 20% for 10 minutes and leaves behind a Cracked Hourglass.

Lost Tuskarr Kite is attached to Lost Arvillo, who travels between the Uktulut Outpost and Uktulut Pier on the Waking Shores' western coast. When Lost Arvillo stops at one of the two docks, the kite will temporarily fall down into the water and become interactable. The Dragonscale Expedition is looking for it in Wanted: Lost Tuskarr Kite

Lost Explorers are located in the Hissing Grotto in the Waking Shores.
Lost Elemental is a fire elemental located in Upper Frostlands in the Azure Span.

The Lost Grotto is a scythid-infested cave in the northeastern portion of Caldera of the Menders in northwestern Forbidden Reach. Scythid Steamstalkers control the cave. A Forbidden Hoard chest can spawn at in the back, guarded by two elite Scythid Aggressors.

The Lost Atheneum is a ruined area overrun by tarasek and beetles immediately southwest of the Froststone Vault in north-central Forbidden Reach. The waterfall and river course in the area are also listed as part of the atheneum. Beyond the vault, the area is bordered by the Old Weyrn Grounds to the southeast and south, the Aerie Chasm to the southwest, and the Scaleborn Pass to the Caldera of the Menders to the west. A Dragonscale Expedition Flag is atop the highest ruined tower in the atheneum.

Lost Expedition Notes is found at in the Expedition Notes found on a table of the upper level of a building at Talonlords' Perch in the Forbidden Reach. This is one of the nine books required for Librarian of the Reach.

A Lost Expedition Scout corpse can be found in a cave clutching a Canteen of Suspicious Water in the Roaring Dragonsprings, Ohn'ahran Plains. The cause of death could be either from Sulfuric Ragers or drowning.
Loszkeleth's Blighted Skullhelm drops from the Blight of Galakrond in Dawn of the Infinite.

Lucifron is one of the four flamewaker captains of Ragnaros, and the first boss of Molten Core.

In 2010, the event was expanded to about two weeks and additional content added; see Love is in the Air (original) for the previous version. The lower rise is Thunder Bluff's main hub of trade, and also contains some professional trainers, as well as several points of interest, such as the inn, the bank, the auction house, and a mailbox. It connects to the middle rise and high rise through the wind rider roost and paths along the edges of the mesa, and to Hunter Rise and Spirit Rise by separate rope bridges. A pair of hydraulic lifts enable the tauren to access the plains of Mulgore below.

While any text editor can edit Lua files, many contain additional Lua specific features.

These are standard Lua functions available in most Lua parsers. Arguably, we could just refer to the [http://www.lua.org Lua web site], but a few functions differ slightly in Blizzard's implementation. They are all documented here for consistency.

Low Common is a language used by many races, although the use of Low Common suggests only a looser or simpler understanding of Common rather than the user necessarily being of low intellect. Low Common is not to be confused with "broken Common" which is apparently different. Some of the most famous phrases which may be examples of Low Common, include the battle cries of kobolds, "You no take candle!", and ogres, "Me smash! You die!" It is also used by many of the troll tribes of the world that descended so far into barbarism that they had forgotten the Zandali language. Separate dialects of Low Common may exist based on a race's culture; Nerglish is said to be a low aquatic tongue akin to Lo

Addons in World of Warcraft share a single execution environment. As a result, all Addons have access to the same global variables. If one Addon creates a global variable named "foo", then all other addons can use (or overwrite) that same variable. This allows for some really useful things to happen; the most frequently used tactic that takes advantage of this feature is hooking. Unfortunately, this can also cause some problems in addons. They will conflict if more than one Addon tries to use the same name for a variable. As a result, Addon authors must ensure that their Addons don't conflict by doing one (or more) of the following: #Using assuredly-unique names for variables, such as MyAddo

Its rough-hewn walls and floor were moist. Where an empty meeting room was within the tower, here was a dungeon bedecked with unoccupied iron chains. Luck of the Draw is an aura effect applied in dungeons when a pickup group is formed through Dungeon Finder. It scales by increments of 5%, up to 15%, for each random player in the group. The intent is "to help make up for the lack of coordination, communication, and familiarity that pick up groups suffer relative to organized groups of guild members and friends."

To collect Lovely Charms, players must have the Lovely Charm Collector's Kit in their inventory, which is available from . Then go kill mobs and/or players that would grant honor or XP. You need not loot these mobs; the charms are created automatically in your inventory when the mob dies as long as you have the Lovely Charm Collector's Kit. In a group or raid, these appear to be awarded randomly; you do not have to land the killing blow to get the charms. These items stack in lots of 40 and you can have more than one stack in your inventory at one time. Not all targets you kill will give you a charm, and you do not have a higher chance to gain Lovely Charms if the enemy is more level-appropr

Lu'minellia was an ancient suit of armor crafted during Dath'Remar Sunstrider's reign and worn by the ancient high elven kings. It was last worn by King Anasterian Sunstrider during the Scourge invasion of Quel'Thalas, the king's last battle. While the king's blade Felo'melorn was reforged, much of Lu'minellia's fate is unknown, though it was still on Anasterian's person when his body was recovered. At least one piece was retrieved, the Coronet of the Lu'minellia, which now resides within the Hall of the Guardian in Dalaran.

The Low Road is the pathway found beneath the High Road in the Southern Barrens, stretching between Honor's Stand and the Overgrowth. Kilrok Gorehammer refers to it as his trail, and sends adventurers to kill Honor's Stand Footmen and Honor's Stand Officers along the trail, calling it the Alliance's toll for using his road. Henry Zykes, a surveyor for the Northwatch Expeditionary Force, can also be found wandering the Low Road with his two Survey Assistants.

Luis Barriga is a former lead game designer for World of Warcraft and game director for . In a article published on August 11, 2021, the gaming website cited internal sources that claimed Barriga -- along with Jesse McCree and Jonathan LeCraft -- were let go from Blizzard Entertainment. This was later confirmed the same day by a spokesperson for Activision Blizzard, stating that they "are no longer with the company".
